prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic night still from the cab of a UK ambulance, camera low between the two front seats, wide 24mm lens. Bottom of frame: the driver's hands strangling the steering wheel, knuckles pale, a sleeve of a plain dark-green uniform. The dashboard glows faintly. Top two-thirds: a windscreen streaming with rain, one wiper caught mid-sweep. Just beyond the bonnet, lit hard by the ambulance's headlights, a police motorcycle outrider in a soaked hi-vis jacket and white helmet stands astride his bike, one gloved hand held up flat, visor down, unmoved. Above him a red traffic light blooms through the wet glass, sodium-orange streetlamps smeared behind, blue emergency light flickering across the rain drops. Shot on 35mm film, heavy grain, underexposed, slightly tilted handheld. No readable text, no logos. Thanks.
